cli.help.intro: Shows your Claude Code, Codex and Copilot sessions and their agents, read from the session records on this computer.
cli.help.privacy: Only reads local files. No network requests, no data collection.
cli.opt.watch: Keep refreshing in place (press q or Ctrl+C to quit)
cli.opt.window: Show sessions active in the last N minutes (default {n})
cli.opt.stale: Minutes without new records before an agent counts as inactive (default {n})
cli.opt.provider: Which records to read: all, claude, codex or copilot (default all)
cli.opt.here: Only sessions whose folder is the current directory or inside it
cli.opt.session: Show one session in detail: timeline, result, changed files, errors and how to resume (ID or the start of it)
cli.opt.today: Also add up today's API-equivalent cost (reads all of today's records)
cli.opt.noToday: With --watch, don't add up today's cost
cli.opt.seenAll: Treat finished results as already seen (dark green instead of bright green)
cli.opt.json: Print JSON instead of text (one line per refresh with --watch)
cli.opt.lang: Language (default: from LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES or LANG)
cli.opt.noColor: No colors (also when NO_COLOR is set or the output isn't a terminal)
cli.opt.color: Always use colors, even when the output isn't a terminal
cli.empty: No Claude Code, Codex or Copilot sessions were active in the last {n} minutes.
cli.empty.here: No sessions from {dir} were active in the last {n} minutes.
cli.more: …{n} more lines (make the window taller to see them)
cli.detail.none: No details yet. They appear after the next record is written.
cli.error.badProvider: Unknown provider “{value}”. Use all, claude, codex or copilot.
cli.error.seeHelp: Run with --help to see the options.
cli.error.noSession: No session matches “{id}”. It may have been inactive for more than {n} minutes; try a larger --window.
cli.error.ambiguous: “{id}” matches {n} sessions. Type more of the ID.
